description: Issue #145 (ADR adr-scope-derivation.md, layer L3): the residue L1 cannot reach. The acceptance criteria actively demand a unit test, the issue declares only a shell script — an ecosystem the derivation has no rule for (ADR 13.2: `*.bats` / `test_*.sh` are named after an intent, not a path) — so nothing is derived and the future scope.allow holds no test path at all. Dispatching that plan spends a whole worker run on a scope gate the worker cannot resolve, so the planner raises ONE warning and ONE open question instead, dropping the run to `partial`. The question quotes the criterion VERBATIM, which is what makes confirming a false positive a matter of seconds rather than a trip to the issue. Note what does NOT change: suspected_files and scope_defaults are exactly what they were before this detector existed — 裁定 A (ADR section 8), an inference may stop the machine but may not instruct it.
